title: JSFL: doc.convertToSymbol uses centroid instead of bounding-box top-left for registration point
description: In packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts around line 2276-2285, convertToSymbol computes the symbol registration point as the centroid (average position) of selected objects. Flash Professional uses the top-left corner of the selection's bounding box. The MCP library_convert_to_symbol tool already does this correctly with Math.min of visual bounds. Fix: use the same bounding-box top-left approach in the JSFL implementation.
